title: Umakhi Oqinileyo Wosindiso
intro: Lo mntu, owayenomonde omkhulu nokuqiniseka okungagungqiyo, wanikela iminyaka engenakubalwa kumsebenzi kaThixo, ejongene nokugculelwa nokulahlwa okungapheliyo. Ibali labo libubungqina obunamandla bokholo xa bejamelene nokungakholelwa okukhulu, nto leyo eyakhokelela kwisiganeko esibalulekileyo esatshintsha ihlabathi.
clues: Ndichithe ixesha elide kakhulu ebomini bam ndibiza abantu bam ukuba banqule u-Allah.
Abantu bam bandigculela kwaye bandityhola ngokuba nempazamo ecacileyo kunye nokuphambana.
Ndayalelwa ukuba ndakhe into engaqhelekanga kuluntu lwam olungenamhlaba.
Bambalwa kuphela abakholwayo baza bajoyina mna nosapho lwam kolu lwakhiwo lukhethekileyo.
Ndandithwele izibini zazo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo ebhodini, njengoko u-Allah wayeyalele.
Umkhukula omkhulu wagubungela umhlaba, wasindisa kuphela abo babekunye nam emkhombeni wam, ngoxa unyana wam wabhubha ngenxa yokungakholwa kwakhe.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
